entries.3c8517d5fc501158: This business centers on operating the travel comparison site "Travelko". "Travelko" is a metasearch site that lets users search and compare, online and in one place, travel products such as package tours, hotels and air tickets sold by more than 1,500 booking sites (as of the end of March 2026), including major domestic travel agencies, domestic and overseas OTAs, and domestic and overseas hotels and airlines. Users can use the service free of charge to find travel products that match their preferred conditions and make reservations or inquiries. The consolidated subsidiary Hotel Skip Co., Ltd. operates the hotel booking site "Hotelia" and the air ticket booking site "Travelia", and also sells travel products to corporate customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,453 million.

Users can search across tour, hotel, air ticket and other categories, and the site also carries "Travel.co Matome," which compiles local reviews and selected reviews.
